ideas.pitch: Automated case study analyzer and PowerPoint presentation generator tailored for business and management case competitions.
ideas.title: CaseFlow Executive AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the specific case study format and executive summary presentation requirements of Round 2 and Round 3 will resonate strongly with business-oriented judges looking for rapid analytical tooling.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered rapid quiz generation and adaptive learning platform to help participants ace competitive online screening rounds.
ideas.title: QuizPrep Adaptive Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the initial online quiz round format by creating a valuable tool for future participants, appealing to general hackathon judges who value educational utilities.

ideas.pitch: A live presentation and scoring dashboard that simulates jury evaluations and provides real-time feedback on pitch deck delivery metrics.
ideas.title: VerdictSim Jury Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Final Jury Presentation round by providing a practical solution for rehearsal, making it instantly relatable and impressive to the panel evaluating final presentations.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined tool for converting raw textual case notes and financial spreadsheets into structured, beautiful executive summary slide decks.
ideas.title: ExecDeck Automator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact bottleneck of Round 2 case study submissions where teams struggle to format comprehensive executive summaries under tight deadlines.

ideas.pitch: A team formation and milestone tracking platform optimized for fast-paced multi-round competitions with strict submission deadlines.
ideas.title: RegTrack Launchpad
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the operational workflow of multi-stage competitions like ThinCovation 2026, demonstrating acute awareness of timeline management and team collaboration.
